verdict.rationale: The GitHub README claims built-in real-time monitoring and alerting, and the docs have an OpenTelemetry page, which suggests telemetry can reach an external observability stack. A community user also calls the built-in observability decent. However, the evidence is only a README claim and a page title, with no detail on what is exported or how alerts are configured. Missing for 10: documented export of failure-rate, latency and queue-depth metrics (e.g. Prometheus/OTel metrics), details of alert rules and destinations, and independent hands-on corroboration of export and alerting.
